sloka: अथ ते विश्वकर्माणं शिल्पिनां वरमव्ययम् ।ऊचुः समेत्य संहृष्टा राक्षसा रघुसत्तम ।। ७.५.१९ ॥
transliteration: atha te viśvakarmāṇaṁ śilpināṁ varamavyayam ।ūcuḥ sametya saṁhṛṣṭā rākṣasā raghusattama ।। 7.5.19 ॥

translations.english: O best of Raghu's lineage, then those delighted Rakshasas, having met Vishwakarma, the best and imperishable among artisans, spoke to him.
